title: Add your business logo
blurb: Upload your logo so it shows on invoices, emails and booking pages.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Open Business Profile
steps.body: Click **Business Profile** in the Settings menu.

steps.title: Find the logo box
steps.body: At the top of **General Information** you will see **Business Logo**. Click the image box to upload.

steps.title: Choose your file
steps.body: Pick a PNG or JPG of your logo. A square version or one with a clear background looks best at small sizes.
steps.tip: Wide logos can look tiny. If you have a square or icon version, use that.

steps.title: Save
steps.body: Click **Update Information** so the new logo sticks.

steps.title: Check it
steps.body: Open a test invoice or booking page later to see the logo in place.
